title: Creature Collaboration
description: CREATURE COLLABORATION: Design suggestions for STAR WARS trilogy aliens came from many fronts. And details that didn't work on one creature sometimes showed up on another. An early Rancor monster (front, by Joe Johnston) had dangling, grasping tusks to hold victims before devouring them. A form of the tusks, smaller but more numerous, showed up on Squid Head (back), designed by Chris Walas in a sketch by Nilo Rodis-Jamero.
